notifications.title: Disaster Desk long renders take ~7 h and die when the cloud session goes idle
notifications.detail: L-20261122-42's full render (8 min, heavy 3D) ran at ~35 min per 40 s chunk on the 4-core container. The container was reclaimed twice mid-render when the session had no running task; finished chunks survived and the render resumed, but a scheduled Studio run that ends its turn will lose the render.
notifications.fix: 1. Either keep long Disaster Desk videos lighter on 3D (the renderer's cost is the 3D beats), or 2. have Studio keep a background session task alive for the whole render (re-armed every 2 h), or 3. move long renders to a GitHub Actions job.

notifications.title: Chapters for directed long videos must be written by hand
notifications.detail: renderer/remotion.py (render.json 'chapters') only reads beats with scene 'chapter'; directed long videos mark chapters in params.chapter, so YouTube chapters come out as only 'Intro' unless written into the description (done by hand for L-20261122-42).
notifications.fix: 1. Add a feedback note for the auditor or improver: collect params.chapter beats as chapters in renderer/remotion.py, with a test.

notifications.title: Hyatt long video title states a disputed phone call as fact
notifications.detail: L-20261121-42 is titled 'The Hyatt Walkway Collapse: One Phone Call Doubled the Load'. Studio's fact reviewer failed this same wording on 22 Nov: the engineering firm disputed receiving the call, and the federal report says the rod change (not a call) doubled the load. Suggested: 'One Rod Change Doubled the Load on This Walkway'.
notifications.fix: 1. On the dashboard, edit the title of L-20261121-42 before it publishes (or in YouTube Studio after).
